title: A mission that was only ever added, never configured, is owner work on the idle hours card, as live's missions 7 and 8 are
prompt:
Read crates/spawn-postgres/src/experience.rs (the `owner_work` of the `missions` rows behind `/api/scorecard/fleet`, objective 062), crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/fleet.rs (`idle`) and web/src/fleetDecisions.ts (`decisionsFromApi`), and how a mission gets its work from a backlog (`objectives` on its `mission.configured` record, or on a legacy mission row).

The problem, as the owner reads the Scorecard after 062 went live (bf1f5c56, deployed 04:35; lead-mac). 062 has had no effect. The live `/api/scorecard/fleet?window=7d` still says {"idle": true, "owner_work": false} for the two owner-work missions, #7 (112.5 / 148.6 h) and #8 (111.0 / 145.2 h), and the card still flags them idle, its only badges. Missions 7 and 8 have a `mission.added` record (events 4617 and 7514, 11-06) and no `mission.configured` at all. The owner_work query counts a mission with no configuration record as not owner work, so it excludes exactly the live owner missions. A mission that was never configured has no objective backlog: its work comes from the owner, like a mission configured with none.

Required behaviour.
(a) A mission with no configuration record before the window's end (no `mission.configured`, no legacy mission row) is owner work: its `/api/scorecard/fleet` row is {owner_work true, idle false}, whatever its text says. Its idle hours are kept.
(b) A mission whose last configuration has an objective backlog is as today: owner_work false, idle as before. A mission configured with no backlog stays owner work (062).
(c) web/src/fleetDecisions.ts's `decisionsFromApi` rows say the same through `ownerWork` and `idle`, and the module keeps loading with node alone.
(d) 043 and 062 stay green: 043's three missions are configured with a backlog, so their idle flags do not change.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/077.sh, seeded like live through `spawn_control_record`; `spawn serve` answers. Mission 4 is configured with a backlog. Missions 7 and 8 have only `mission.added`: 7 with an "Owner work on ..." text and 8 with a text that says nothing of owner work. No mission has a task. Read through `GET /api/scorecard/fleet?window=24h`:
- (1) missions 7 and 8 are {idle false, owner_work true};
- (2) mission 4 is {idle true, owner_work false};
- (3) under node, decisionsFromApi over the answer gives [idle, ownerWork] [true, false] for 4 and [false, true] for 7 and 8.
It fails with 1 on bf1f5c56: 7 and 8 read {idle true, owner_work false}.

The product reason. The idle badge is only a signal if it points at a backlog mission with nothing in work. While it still flags the owner's own missions, the owner learns to ignore it, which is what 062 was meant to stop. The fix must key on what the records say about a backlog, never on a mission's name or text.

Rules: never edit the protected paths, which the gate rejects: rsi/, scripts/ (scripts/rsi/, scripts/blackbox/, scripts/e2e.sh among them), deploy/, all of web/ except web/src/, web/test/ and web/index.html, rust-toolchain files and .cargo/. The gate also rejects fewer runnable tests than the base, any lint relaxation and any build-time code. The gate builds offline from the cargo caches already on the host. Keep every existing check green and add tests of your own for the new behaviour: a spawn-postgres test through the real store that a mission with only `mission.added` is owner work and not idle, beside a backlog mission that is idle, and update the doc comment on the query that says a never-configured mission is not owner work.
